name: bash
arguments:
{"command":"cd /workspace && python - <<'PY'
import ast
from src.component import count_powerful_integers
module = ast.parse(open('tests.py').read())
for node in ast.walk(module):
    if isinstance(node, ast.Assert):
        call = node.test.left
        args = [ast.literal_eval(arg) for arg in call.args]
        expected = ast.literal_eval(node.test.comparators[0])
        actual = count_powerful_integers(*args)
        print(tuple(args), 'expected:', expected, 'actual:', actual)
        if args[1] - args[0] <= 100000:
            matches = [n for n in range(max(1, args[0]), args[1] + 1)
                       if str(n).endswith(args[3]) and all(int(c) <= args[2] for c in str(n))]
            print('  brute force:', len(matches), 'sample:', matches[:12])
PY"}
